title: The Earth seen from space on a given day: true-colour imagery from VIIRS
provider: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)
licence: NASA imagery: no restrictions on use; acknowledge NASA GIBS and the data source (NASA Earthdata use policy)

previous.description: The day used to fill the gaps of the first, normally the day before

width.description: Width of the image in pixels (360°)

height.description: Height of the image in pixels (180°)

yesterday.description: Yesterday's VIIRS (Suomi NPP) mosaic, gaps filled from the day before, 8192 x 4096 (about 13 MB)

format: JPEG, equirectangular (EPSG:4326), longitude -180 to 180, latitude 90 to -90; corrected reflectance rendered as true colour; black where there is no data (gaps between days, polar night)
coverage: Global, daily, from 2012 (VIIRS) or 2000 (MODIS); 250 m at full resolution
citation: We acknowledge the use of imagery from the NASA Worldview application (https://worldview.earthdata.nasa.gov), part of the NASA Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
